characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Through-thickness embedding, grinding and polishing performed separately for hot-rolled and heat-treated samples
characterization_methods.purpose: analyse the alloys at the different processing conditions (hot-rolling and tempering)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: 20 kV; e.g. Fig. 10 panel shows a 20 µm scale bar
characterization_methods.key_findings: Austenite grains show fine parallel striations with different directions in each grain; only κ-carbides are detected as secondary phases along grain boundaries for 9Al-30Mn-1C at 600 °C (Fig. 10(b)).
characterization_methods.technique: Scanning Electron Microscopy (Secondary Electron Images, SEI)

characterization_methods.purpose: provide qualitative information on the local phase composition

characterization_methods.key_findings: 9Al-30Mn-1C tempered at 600 °C shows a macro-hardness of 330 HV (Table 8)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: 5 kg load applied for all indentations; 5 indentations per sample; Minitab18 software used to verify data consistency and exclude outliers
characterization_methods.purpose: macro-hardness measurement of each alloy/processing condition

computational_details.simulation_method: CALPHAD equilibrium phase-fraction calculation (phase amount vs temperature)

interfaces.phase_evolution: For 9Al-30Mn-1C tempered at 600 °C no austenite transformation was detected; the only secondary phases detected were κ-carbides along γ grain boundaries. This contrasts with 9Al-10Mn-1C at 600 °C, where austenite decomposed by discontinuous precipitation into γ + κ lamellae.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Vickers hardness of 9Al-30Mn-1C: 330 HV after 600 °C tempering versus 216 HV in the hot-rolled state (Table 8)

processing_steps.method: casting in a 100 kW vacuum induction furnace
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Resulted in 0.5 kg ingots (Table 1); applied to all the alloyed steels including 9Al-30Mn-1C.
Ingots were hot-rolled at 1150 °C obtaining 5 mm flat-products; this is the parent process proc_hot-rolled-1150c.
Water quenching applied after hot rolling.
Samples were heat treated at 600 °C for 30 min; at 600 °C only slight/incipient reactions are triggered, and for 9Al-30Mn-1C no austenite transformation was detected.
Heat treatment was followed by water quenching.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Vickers macro-hardness, 5 kg load applied for all indentations, 5 indentations per sample

phases_present.morphology: matrix grains featuring fine parallel striations whose direction differs from grain to grain
secondary phase located along grain boundaries (only κ-carbides detected)

structures.overall_structure: Austenitic (γ) matrix whose grains feature fine parallel striations (each grain shows a single striation direction that changes from grain to grain); κ-carbides are the only secondary phase detected, lying along grain boundaries. After 600 °C tempering no austenite transformation was detected for 9Al-30Mn-1C.
